claims.text: Many reviewers report significant clearing of acne, blemishes, and improved skin texture, often within days to weeks.
Several reviewers with conditions like rosacea, eczema, psoriasis, and hyperpigmentation report improvements in redness and overall complexion.
Some reviewers say the product performs comparably to prescription or expensive treatments at a fraction of the cost.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including a weird residue or buildup on the face.
Some reviewers report receiving counterfeit or poorly packaged product, including leaks and inauthentic items.

qa.q: Will this help with my acne and oily skin?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews report it helped with acne and oily skin: users say their skin cleared and breakouts stopped [1][3][5], and it helped control sebum so the face gets less oily [6]. One reviewer notes only a few weeks of use with no drastic changes yet [6].

claims.text: Users report their skin cleared and they stopped getting breakouts [1][3][5].
It helped control sebum so the face doesn't get as oily [6].
One reviewer using it only a few weeks noticed no drastic changes yet [6].

qa.q: Can I use it with vitamin C or retinol?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it cause purging or breakouts?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report bad breakouts [5], while others say it cleared their acne or reduced breakouts [1][4][6].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the product caused bad breakouts and had to discontinue use.
Other reviewers report it cleared or reduced their acne and breakouts.

qa.q: How long until I see results?
qa.answer: Timelines vary widely: one reviewer saw significant improvement in 3 days [2] and another saw visible results in 18 days [1], while a third using it for a few weeks noticed no drastic changes [5]. One reviewer also reported a mild breakout in the first two or three days before their skin adjusted [4].

claims.text: One reviewer saw significant improvement after 3 days of use [2].
Another reviewer saw visible results in 18 days [1].
A reviewer using it for a few weeks noticed no drastic changes [5].
One reviewer had a mild breakout in the first two or three days before their skin adjusted [4].

qa.q: Is it good value for the price?
qa.answer: Reviews mention price only indirectly: one reviewer notes that buying three 60ml bottles directly from the company for $32 (about $11 a bottle) is cheaper than the 30ml sold here [3][4]. No review directly states whether the product is good value for the price.
